findings.detail: The raw SOI presents amortized cost and fair value as USD-denominated dollar amounts, but the extracted cost_currency is the XBRL unit identifier U_USD instead of canonical USD.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 currency-field check. The source SOI table labels the valuation columns Amortized Cost and Fair Value and shows dollar signs for the same row group, including Fenix Intermediate, LLC with dollar-denominated par, amortized cost, and fair value amounts. The stored value U_USD is not the canonical USD currency expected for BDC valuation fields, so this is a normalization/extraction defect rather than a non-USD source fact.
